title.full: Order of payment for medical bills

summary.text: Employer and private insurance pay first. MediShield Life pays next.

details.heading: Claims and limits
details.body: MediShield Life and Integrated Shield Plans pay subject to claim limits, deductible, and co-insurance.

steps.name: First payment
steps.text: Your employer, private insurance, or other third party must pay first.

steps.name: Second payment
steps.text: MediShield Life or your Integrated Shield Plan pays for the portion of the bill not covered by your employer or private insurance.

steps.name: Third payment
steps.text: MediSave is used after MediShield Life.

example_phrasings: I am covered by Employer Medical Benefits. Can I claim from MediShield Life as well? Who pays first?
Can I use MediShield Life with employer medical benefits?
Does my employer insurance pay before MediShield Life?

quotes.text: 1. Employer, private insurance, other third party pays first 2. Followed by MediShield Life (MSHL)/Integrated Shield Plan (IP)
1. Employer, private insurance, other third party pays first
2. Followed by MediShield Life (MSHL)/Integrated Shield Plan (IP)
MSHL/IP will pay for the portion of the bill that is not covered by employer, private insurance and other third-party payers, subject to claim limits, deductible and co-insurance.
